citations.excerpt: The persecution began on the twenty-third day of February, 303, the feast of the Terminalia

facts.value: Series of edicts against Christians issued under Diocletian and his co-regent Maximian.

citations.excerpt: In 303 Diocletian issued in rapid succession three edicts, each more severe than its predecessor. Maximian issued the fourth, the worst of all, April 30, 304.

facts.value_before_verify: Series of imperial edicts against Christians issued under Diocletian and his co-emperors.
